fluidSubtitles needs Accessibility permission to type Transcription into other apps. Theater captions on your screen do not require this.
fluidSubtitles needs microphone access to record your voice for live transcription and translation. Your audio is processed locally and never sent to external servers.
fluidSubtitles needs permission to control system events for managing launch at startup settings.
fluidSubtitles uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice and translate it locally.
